summaries.bioinformatics_lead: Bioinformatics Lead Scientist with 10+ years of experience in precision medicine across oncology and rare diseases. Expert in designing, building, and productionizing end-to-end applied bioinformatics and multi-omics pipelines for clinical workflows. Conceived and built comprehensive cross-functional bioinformatics stacks from scratch, delivering reproducible, scalable, and regulatory-ready solutions that integrate NGS analysis, clinical variant interpretation, phenotype-based prioritization, and data-driven insights. Active builder of AI-powered tools spanning multi-agent systems, clinical AI apps, and developer infrastructure.

summaries.program_lead_ai: Program and engineering leader with 10+ years of experience managing cross-functional technical programs, Agile delivery, and validation/QC frameworks. summaries.multi_omics_leader: Bioinformatics and multi-omics leader with 10+ years in precision oncology, leading scientists and owning technical delivery across R&D, clinical, and biopharma collaborations, including Takeda, Genentech, Cleveland Clinic Florida, and Bugworks. summaries.bioinformatics_ai_engineer: Bioinformatics & AI Engineer with 10+ years of technical experience designing, building, and deploying end-to-end biological foundation-model systems, agentic workflows, and reproducible multi-omics pipelines. Expertise combining LLMs with validated bioinformatics tools, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and systematic evaluation frameworks (Promptfoo, DeepEval, Ragas) to minimize hallucination risk and assess biological relevance. Proven track record in high-throughput NGS pipeline engineering (Nextflow, AWS HealthOmics, Docker, GPU acceleration), clinical variant interpretation (ACMG/AMP), and large-scale public data curation (TCGA, ClinVar, gnomAD) for precision oncology and translational research.

bullets: Led the Bioinformatics R&D team: defined technical roadmap, recruited and mentored scientists, drove project prioritization, and aligned strategy with executive leadership.

Designed multi-agent orchestration workflows for vendor order management, coordinating specialized agents, external tools, and contextual memory with human-in-the-loop validation at critical decision points.

Designed and maintained golden datasets, benchmark queries, and expected-answer sets that powered repeatable evaluation of retrieval quality, response accuracy, hallucination reduction, and regression testing across GenAI applications.

Built reusable prompt libraries and test suites (zero-shot, few-shot, role-based, multi-turn, edge-case) using Promptfoo and DeepEval to validate GenAI feature accuracy and consistency before release.
Built multi-stage annotation and prioritization pipelines applying AMP/ASCO/CAP guidelines across public and proprietary annotation sources.
Designed and implemented input ingestion, monitoring, and reporting frameworks that reduced manual review time by 20%.
Established risk management practices for bioinformatics pipelines - identified potential failure points, data-quality risks, and downstream repercussions, and implemented mitigation strategies.
Designed structured upskilling sessions leveraging supplemental projects beyond core deliverables, improving engagement, critical thinking, and problem-solving across team members.
Developed comprehensive workflows for microsatellite instability (MSI), homologous recombination deficiency (HRD), mutational signatures, tumor mutational burden (TMB), and indel burden.
Built high-throughput variant calling stacks on AWS following GATK best practices, including mutation and CNV calling, and biomarker extraction.
Built and led the bioinformatics team: recruited, trained, mentored, and reviewed the work of 4 members; created custom training protocols that accelerated onboarding and competency development.
Designed input-agnostic workflows supporting multiple formats (FASTQ, BAM, VCF, structured reports) across diverse commercial vendors (4BC, Tempus, Caris, Foundation Medicine, Alacris).
Built cancer driver and copy number variation (CNV) vs. mRNA expression correlation databases for 30+ cancer types using public datasets and computational tools.
Developed automated multi-omics interpretation pipelines for high-impact clinical trial datasets from biopharma partners including Takeda and Genentech.
Created an in-house Variant of Uncertain Significance (VUS) reclassification pipeline using an Ensembl-based approach, improving classification accuracy by >40%.

Analyzed single-cell RNA-seq data from Human Protein Atlas normal-tissue samples with Seurat, Scanpy, and limma to establish in-silico control baselines for distinguishing cancer-specific expression signatures.
Applied CIBERSORTx and MuSiC bulk RNA-seq deconvolution to resolve cancer-specific markers within heterogeneous tumor samples and improve multi-omics interpretation.
Developed and benchmarked secondary analysis pipelines (Illumina DRAGEN, NVIDIA Parabricks, Sentieon), optimized for turnaround time, resource cost, and variant calling accuracy.

Led custom panel design for liquid-biopsy samples; collaborated with Cleveland Clinic Florida to build a machine learning pipeline using longitudinal genomic data to predict early relapse in Melanoma.
Built an analytical framework to process pediatric cancer cases; served as primary domain owner for pediatric hematological malignancies.
Designed and implemented a Panel of Normals (PoN) workflow for CNV and mutation calling using ~100 cases, improving support for tumor-only clinical analyses.
Created multiple tertiary analysis workflows (GSEA, pathway enrichment, PCA, statistical models, ML pipelines) for biomarker discovery and treatment-response characterization.
Developed multi-omics interpretation pipelines for the Foundation Medicine clinical genomic dataset (18,000+ patient cases).
Compiled a comprehensive diagnostic assay and genomic test inventory across 88 cancer types based on NCCN, FDA, and international clinical guidelines.
Curated therapeutic rationale libraries to support computational biology predictions, reducing turnaround time for live clinical case analyses by >40%.
Analyzed 200+ complex cancer cases, gaining deep expertise in target selection using biological network models and drug interaction mechanisms in precision oncology.
Conducted rigorous benchmarking of external sequencing pipelines (DNAnexus, BeOne, MedGenome) to establish analytical validity, confidence, and cross-platform reproducibility.
Developed an in-house variant annotation and filtering pipeline with a custom tier classification system, lowering processing costs and enabling clinical interpretability.
Processed, interpreted, and harmonized multi-omics outputs (karyotyping, aCGH, IHC, somatic mutations) for >500 cases, translating insights into automated data-harmonization ETL pipelines.
Curated and automated retrospective in-house dataset creation by integrating patient and cell-line data from >10,000 GDSC, TCGA, and published clinical studies.
Standardized genomic data interpretation from external medical partners including Columbia University, University of Florida, Cedars-Sinai, Mayo Clinic, and Washington University.
Automated report-generation workflows using reproducible pipelines and templates, reducing preparation time from ~15 hours to just minutes per week.
